out_of_scope.reason: Nothing in the implemented subset creates a Line. None of the 32 in-scope spells has one, and neither do the 14 monsters or the 4 species. The Line content (Lightning Bolt, Dragonborn Breath Weapon, dragon breath) is all outside §1.1. The engine has no Line geometry (geometry.in_area covers cone, cube and sphere), so a test would have to invent an API. Per CLAUDE.md, content the engine doesn't implement gets no tests.
No in-scope effect specifies a Line length and width, so the clause can't be reached through the engine.
No in-scope Line exists, so whether its point of origin is excluded can't be observed. The matching rule for Cones and Cubes is already tested under R-29 and R-31.
